questions.question: Rohit starts from Point A and walks 20 m towards the north. He takes a left turn, walks 35 m and then takes a left turn, walks 10 m, then takes a left turn, walks 40 m, reaches Point B and stops. Mohan starts from Point Z which is 40 m towards the north of Point A. He walks 30 m towards the east, takes a right turn, walks 40 m, and stops at Point X. What is the shortest distance between Point X and Point A? (All turns are 90-degree turns only.)2526

options: F : K ? O % R x X

questions.question: E, F, M, N, X and Y live on six different floors of the same building. The lowermost floor in the building is numbered 1, the floor above it is numbered 2 and so on, till the topmost floor, which is numbered 6.Only two people live between E and Y. Only two people live between N and F. Only one person lives between M and F. M lives on floor number 1. E lives above F. How many people live above X?2806

A certain number of people are sitting in a row, facing north. No one is sitting to the left of A. A is sitting to the immediate left of B. Only 6 people are sitting between B and J. M is sitting third to the right of J. K is sitting to the immediate right of M. Only 6 people are sitting between K and T.  If T is sitting third from the right end, what is the total number of people seated?1903

This question is based on the five, three-digit numbers given below.(Left)   678          485          217          153          572          (Right)(Example: 697 – First digit = 6, second digit = 9 and third digit = 7)(NOTE: All operations to be done from left to right.)What will be the resultant if the second digit of the highest number is added to the third digit of the lowest number?

Read the given statements and conclusions carefully. Assuming that the information given in the statements is true, even if it appears to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the given conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.Statements: All stoves are ovens.All ovens are forks.No fork is a spoon.Conclusions:I. No stove is a spoon.II. No oven is a spoon.2847
options: Both conclusions I and II follow.
Neither conclusion I nor II follows.
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'A' (Both conclusions I and II follow.) है।

questions.question: In a certain code language,'I have pen paper' is coded as 'op ui ty er','pen paper scissor cover ' is coded as 'ty er qw mn','for this have year' is coded as 'kn lo ui jk' and'pen cover garden this' is coded as 'ty mn pd lo'.(All the codes are two-letter codes only).What is the possible code for ‘for’?2810

This question is based on the following words.EAR  COP  ICH  GELIn each of the words, each vowel is changed to the letter immediately following it in the English alphabetical order and each consonant is changed to the letter immediately preceding it in the English alphabetical order. In how many letter-clusters thus formed, will no vowel appear?2476

There are two statements given,1and 2. These statements may be either independent causes or may be possible effects of independent causes or a common cause. One of these statements may be the possible effect of the other statement. Read both the statements and decide which of the following answer choices correctly depicts the relationship between these two statements.
Statements:
1 Number of suicides among youngsters has been increasing for the last few years.
2 Educational Institutions have created an environment of competition of do or fail among youngsters for the past few years.
options: Both the statements 1 and 2 are independent causes.
Both the statements 1 and 2 are possible effects which cannot have a common cause.
Statement 1 is the cause and statement 2 is its possible effect.
Statement 2 is the cause and statement 1 is its possible effect.
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'D' (Statement 2 is the cause and statement 1 is its possible effect.) है।

A, B, C, D, E, F and G are sitting around a circular table facing the centre. F sits third to the right of A. G sits second to the right of F. C is the immediate neighbour of E and F. B sits second to the right of C. How many people sit between G and E when counted from the left of G ?  1860

Given below is a statement (Cause) followed by possible effects numbered I and II. Read the ‘Cause’ carefully and decide which of them can be possible effect/s.Cause: Due to a severe drought, River F, one of Country L's major rivers, has significantly dried up over the past two years.Effect I: This year, Country L has recorded an all-time high of power generated from renewable sources.Effect II: Over the past year, Country L has achieved its highest-ever harvest of water-intensive crop R since the past decade.
options: Both I and II are possible effects
Only II is a possible effect
Only I is a possible effect
Neither I nor II are possible effects
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'D' (Neither I nor II are possible effects) है।
